name: WMD PLOTTER Hazard Zones
description: Broadcasts WHITWERX Model Display (WMD PLOTTER) CBRN hazard zones — Gaussian plume, blast, radiation, BLEVE, dense-gas, and fire/smoke contours — into TAK as styled, auto-staling drawn shapes. Webhook invocation pushes a plume the moment a responder computes it; the optional schedule keeps a live 'active incidents' layer in sync.

permissions.description: Posts hazard-zone polygons to the map layer.

webhook.description: WMD PLOTTER POSTs a hazard FeatureCollection to this layer's webhook the moment an operator broadcasts an incident — event-driven, no polling lag.

schedule.description: Optional. Polls the configured WMD PLOTTER instance for currently-active incidents and keeps the layer in sync. Leave disabled if you only use event-driven webhook pushes.
